name: HATCHBOX 3D (Hatchbox Inc.)
summary: Long-running Amazon-first US filament label, trading since at least 2014 (HB HATCHBOX trademarks filed 2014/2015). Hatchbox is a brand/importer rather than a factory: standard lines have historically been described as Chinese-manufactured, while the separate PLA MAX line is marketed as USA-made. No specific OEM has been confirmed.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Core 1 kg line; 1 kg black PLA listed at $21.99

product_lines.name: PLA MAX
product_lines.notes: Explicitly marketed as USA-made and biobased; sold via the 'USA Made' collection

product_lines.name: Cleaning filament
product_lines.notes: Nozzle cleaning filament; base polymer not specified

additional_notes: Corporate address is not published on the official site and did not surface in trademark records beyond the owner name Hatchbox Inc.; US base is inferred from Amazon/US retail presence and from the 'USA Made' line being marketed as a distinct exception. Manufacturing origin for standard lines rests on a 2018 retailer account (Printed Solid) describing Hatchbox as 'a Chinese manufactured filament' sold wholesale, alongside a note that the wholesale program was discontinued after 2017-2018 supply issues; whether that remains current is unverified. Also sells 3D printer resin. Instagram and Facebook entries were assembled from the handles @hatchbox3d and HATCHBOX3D cited in research rather than from links captured directly. No build plates or print surfaces were found, but this is an unverified negative so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: Manufacturing origin is split and only partly evidenced: the 'China' entry comes from a single 2018 third-party retailer blog post, while 'United States' comes from Hatchbox's own PLA MAX marketing. No OEM factory is named by any source, and headquarters location is inferred rather than documented.
